text: WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis: Fourth edition 154 DOI statements are summarized by the WHO steering committee at the start of the meeting. Selected individuals with intellectual or research involvement were invited as technical resource persons to provide technical input and answer technical questions. These individuals did not participate in the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) evaluation process and were excluded from the group discussions when recommendations were developed.
